paragraphs.text: Tuknir Deathlock is a legendary wizard whose lifetime and origins on Dominaria are unknown.

Tuknir Deathlock is an enigmatic and adventurous wizard , embodying a distinct set of arcane powers, and a thirst for exploration. Tuknir is an explorer of the Æther , often finding himself in unconventional physical realms. Whether this means that he is a planeswalker exploring the Blind Eternities , or if he can access the Æther and other realms through some other means than planeswalking is unknown.

Tuknir wears a helmet or headdress formed from the merged skulls of two dinosaurs. He possesses flying , implying he either has wings, possesses the power of flight through magical means like levitation, or rides on a flying mount or object.
Tuknir's lifetime is unknown, as legendary creatures from the Legends set are from many points in time, meaning he may be long deceased, currently alive, or even yet to be born.
